decision: T0.1 matched-quant AR baseline + definitive AR/MTP crossover table for the CONCURRENCY2 gfx1151 MTP tuning campaign
physical_host: gfx1151 (AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S, CachyOS 7.1.6-1, HIP 7.15.0)

protocol.surface: OpenAI-compatible blocking completions HTTP (matched to the MTP diagnostic)
protocol.primary_metric: median aggregate generated completion tokens / simultaneous-release-to-last-response wall
protocol.sampling: greedy top-1; AR rows ignore_eos=true with MTP disabled at the server; MTP rows EOS honored with --speculative-mtp-serving opt_in
protocol.anti_gaming_scope: fixed synthetic prompt diagnostic; the full mtpbench code/general_en/general_ja/mixed_ja_en + heldout gate (T0.4) is required before any retained speculative speed claim

crossover.crossover_width: between c1 and c2; c1 is the only width where serving MTP beats matched-quant AR
crossover.note: Q4_K_M AR c1-c6 are within ~3% of the earlier Q4_K_S SSE diagnostic; the c7 dip (26.40 vs c6 31.80, stdev 0.05%) is reproducible and unexplained - width-bucketing suspect

t03_attribution_from_mtp_raw.per_request_prefill_ms_all_widths: ~4538-4792 (512-token prompt => ~113 tok/s prefill, serial per request)
t03_attribution_from_mtp_raw.batch_wall_equals_summed_per_request_wor: c8 wall 81.6s ~= 8 x (4.8s prefill + 5.3s decode): phases do not overlap across requests
t03_attribution_from_mtp_raw.mechanism: phase-serial scheduler (draft all slots -> verify chunks of <=4 slots -> commit all); verify runs 4-token blocks per slot without AR-style cross-slot position batching (use_wmma_prefill=False in verify jobs); per-step verify ~120 ms per 4-position block vs ~33 ms per 8-position batched AR step
t03_attribution_from_mtp_raw.g1_finding: c1 serving decode phase alone is 128 tok / 4.8s = 26.7 tok/s (faster than the 21.16 tok/s direct leaf); the c1 serving-vs-direct gap is prefill (4.5s = 48% of request wall) plus HTTP/tokenize overhead, not decode

correctness.mtp_strict_generated_id_mismatches: 0 at all widths (24/24 exact at c8)
correctness.interpretation: repeated-token synthetic prompt produces greedy near-ties; batched AR flips ties at c>=4 on both quants (Q4_K_S diagnostic showed the same pattern: c3-c6 3 mismatches, c7-c8 6); target-verified MTP stays exact at every width. Diagnostic-only signal; T0.4 full suite governs retained claims

raw_sources.note: MTP raw per-request backend timings used for T0.3 attribution
